scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=client
scripts.docker:rebuild: npm run docker:remove && npm run docker:build
scripts.docker:start: npm run docker:remove && docker run -d --name personal-website --restart unless-stopped -p 3000:3000 --env-file ./server/.env.docker personal-website
